SSH Master; bağlantı kartları ve klasörl: SSH Master brings connection cards and folders, a full-featured terminal, split view, command shortcuts and an SFTP file manager together in a single Windows app.
Windows için · Hesabım sayfanızdan kişiy: For Windows · Personal download from your My account page
Bağlantılarınızı düzenleyin, birden çok: Organize your connections, work on multiple servers at once, and move your files with drag and drop.
Ad, sunucu, port, kullanıcı ve şifre ya: Create cards with a name, host, port, user, and a password or private key. Test the connection before saving and tag cards with colors.
İç içe klasörler oluşturun, kartları sür: Create nested folders and move cards with drag and drop. Find anything instantly with <kbd>Ctrl+F</kbd>; pick up where you left off with "go to last folder".
Karta çift tıklayın; xterm tabanlı SSH k: Double-click a card to open an xterm-based SSH console in its own window. 256 colors, copy/paste, context menu and reconnect.
Birden çok kartı seçip tek pencerede açı: Select several cards and open them in one window: two side by side, four in a 2×2 grid, up to six panes. Drag the dividers to resize.
Açıkken klavye girdiniz ve kısayollarını: When enabled, your keyboard input and shortcuts go to all connected servers at once; do the same job on every server in one go.
Sık kullandığınız komutları kaydedin; çi: Save the commands you use most; double-click to type them at the cursor, and optionally press Enter too. Drag to reorder.
Sunucu dosyalarında gezinin, terminalin: Browse server files and follow the terminal's current folder. Download, rename, delete and create new folders.
Windows klasörleri ve sürücüleri aynı ek: Windows folders and drives on the same screen. Upload or download with drag and drop between panels and from Windows Explorer.
Bağlantı kütüphaneniz cihazlarınız arası: Your connection library syncs across your devices. It is end-to-end encrypted: only you hold the key, and the server cannot read the content. Turn it off in settings if you prefer.
Şifreler Windows DPAPI ile şifrelenir. S: Passwords are encrypted with Windows DPAPI. The server's host key is saved on first connection; if it changes, the connection is refused.
Her bağlantı için ayrı konsol renk palet: Choose a separate console color palette for each connection; tell your production server apart at a glance.
Küçültünce sistem tepsisinde bekler, kap: Minimized, it waits in the system tray; closed, it hides to the tray. Connect directly from the tray menu, organized by your folder structure.
Terminal yazı boyutunu ayarlardan diledi: Make the terminal font larger or smaller in settings, just as you like.
Bölmeleri açın, kapatın ve aralarında ge: Open, close and switch between panes; hide the panel with a single key.
